holiday_analysis.summary: Thu 11 – Tue 16 Mar 2027 uses exactly 3 days of annual leave (12, 15, 16 Mar) and keeps Raya Day 1 at home. Your child only misses 2 school days (15–16 Mar). Fares will be high: Raya + Term 1 school holiday.
reasons: Overlaps Malaysian school holidays (families travel, fares up)
Major festival outbound rush (Hari Raya Aidilfitri)
Islamic holiday dates are provisional (moon sighting) - confirm with the gazette
holiday_analysis.recommendation: A 6-day trip outside public holidays always needs 4 leave days, so with only 3 days the Raya week is the only way to get 6 days. We fly out on the evening of Raya Day 2 so you still celebrate Raya Day 1 at home, and Ramadan is already over. Book 3-4 months ahead (by Nov-Dec 2026) because fares are high. Seoul is still cold in mid-March (about 0-11°C) and the cherry blossoms have not started yet.

alternatives.note: Needs only 2 leave days and your child misses no school, but you would spend the last days of Ramadan and Raya Day 1 abroad.
5 days instead of 6. Cheap fares and spring weather (about 7-19°C), but your child misses 3 school days.
The full 6 days in spring after the cherry-blossom peak. Needs 4 leave days, one more than you have.

items.name: Hotel check-in + nap
items.notes: You arrived on a red-eye, so rest

items.name: Myeongdong evening walk + street food (choose halal-labelled stalls only)
items.notes: Most stalls are NOT halal-certified. Stick to hotteok (sweet pancake), fruit and egg bread, and avoid meat skewers and fish-cake broth

items.name: Shuttle bus / ITX to Gapyeong → Nami ferry
items.notes: Book a tourist shuttle (about 1.5h) so your child doesn't have to change trains

items.name: Nami Island (ferry + admission)
items.notes: ₩19,000 regular incl. ferry (2026 guide). Preschoolers are free; your 7-year-old may get the discount rate (check). Prayer room at Baplex 2F with wudhu area.

items.name: Lunch: Asian Family Restaurant Dongmoon (KMF halal), Nami Island
items.notes: Reported as the only fully KMF-certified restaurant on the island. Certification date unconfirmed, so check the certificate on the wall.

items.name: Back to Seoul, light dinner at Busan Jib or packed halal snacks

items.notes: Modest dress. Usadan-ro 10-gil below has the densest halal food cluster in Korea.

tips: Base yourselves in Myeongdong. Busan Jib (halal) is walking distance away and Itaewon's halal street is about 15 minutes by taxi.
Check for a KMF halal certificate with a QR code. A 'Muslim-friendly' sign is NOT halal certification.
Korean chains like Kyochon are JAKIM-halal in Malaysia but not in Korea. Don't assume.
Prayer rooms: Seoul Central Mosque, Lotte World, COEX and Nami Island (Baplex 2F).
Busan was dropped. With a relaxed pace and a 7-year-old, 4 full days in Seoul is enough. Add Busan only if you get a 4th leave day.
Changdeokgung, Changgyeonggung and most museums close on Monday; Gyeongbokgung closes on Tuesday. The plan avoids both.
